Experience.title: Professional experience
Experience.intro: My professional journey and the projects that have shaped my growth.

highlights: Developing and maintaining enterprise projects with Laravel, Angular, and Kotlin.
Collaborating across the development cycle of the company's web and mobile applications.
Contributing to feature implementation, bug fixes, and improvements in production environments.

Built a REST API for biometric registration and access using FastAPI and DeepFace, incorporating facial accessory detection such as glasses, caps, and face masks, reducing recognition error rate by 15%.

Developed REST APIs with Laravel for payment processing, invoice stamping, and database management, operating as reusable microservices shared across 5 applications, eliminating module duplication and reducing development time.
Integrated relational and non-relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB into web and mobile applications.
Contributed to the design, planning, development, and maintenance of more than 8 custom enterprise projects in production using React, Next.js, Flutter, and Laravel.
Designed UI/UX interfaces on 4 projects, improving user experience in enterprise web and mobile applications.
Integrated up to 4 custom client-designed sports watches simultaneously via BLE in a Flutter mobile application.
Optimized development workflows using AI-assisted tools for debugging, development, and technical documentation, increasing delivery capacity by managing two projects simultaneously.
Managed deployment, configuration, error monitoring, and updates for 4 mobile applications on Google Play Store and App Store.
Deployed more than 5 web applications across different environments using Vercel, SSH, and FTP.
Dockerized 2 REST APIs and managed deployment of their images on Kubernetes with DigitalOcean, configuring autoscaling from 1 to 3 nodes based on production demand.
